name: Beautiful.ai
summary: Presentation builder whose templates lay themselves out as you type.
best_for: founders, sales and small teams that want consistently good-looking decks fast, where design consistency matters more than pixel-level control
skip_if: you need intricate custom layouts or complex animations (designers want full control), or your whole company workflow is deeply PowerPoint-native
honest_knock: The smart-template engine is the feature and the fence: decks look polished with zero design skill precisely because the system constrains you, so pixel-perfect custom layouts and heavy brand exceptions fight the tool. And note the billing gap: $14.50/mo annual becomes $45 month-to-month, one of the steeper monthly premiums around. If your organisation lives in PowerPoint workflows, test the import/export round-trip before committing.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Beautiful.ai in the 14-day Pro trial that we started with our card. The trial runs on annual billing, so the first bill is $174.00. One prompt gave a polished 8-slide deck in about 55 seconds, but with placeholders instead of figures, and a layout switch dropped the chart. Cancelling took 2 screens with no offer. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day Pro trial with his own card; the trial checkout defaults to annual billing. Our AI assistant ran the test in its own tab on 19 November 2026 from 17:46 CET. The account was in Dutch; we set the language to English in the preferences before the first screenshot. Billing at the start: Current Plan: Pro - You have 14 days remaining in your free trial, Billing Period: Annual, Your next bill of $174.00 will be due when your free trial ends on Dec 03, 2026, Seats: 1 total. Payment history has one line of $0. Core action, a deck from a prompt: Create with AI, the prompt Quarterly update for a small bakery, a few quick questions with the defaults kept, then an outline of 8 slides and the deck about 30 seconds after Generate presentation: about 55 seconds and 5 steps in all. The deck uses placeholders instead of figures, such as Quarterly Performance Review: [Bakery Name], $[Placeholder] and [X]%, with generated bakery photos and a chart slide. Smart Slides: switching the Revenue Drivers chart slide to a list layout took one click, but the chart and the 68% figure did not carry over; Undo brought them back. A template, Corporate Presentation Template, opened in the editor after about 10 seconds. The Brand Kit screen covers colours, typography, decoration, footer and import from PowerPoint; nothing was changed. Share and export, only viewed: Share Securely offers Password Protection and Viewer Authentication; export offers a view link, Offline Player, PDF, PowerPoint and Google Slides, with the note Exported presentations do not support animations or video at this time. Nothing was shared or downloaded. Plans: Pro $14.50 /mo billed annually, Team $40 /mo with 3 seats included billed annually, Enterprise custom. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen; it defaulted to annual billing at $174 a year. Cancelling, done the same day: Billing, Manage plan, Cancel plan. Screen 1, Already working in ChatGPT?, with Continue to cancellation. Screen 2: Are you sure you want to cancel your plan? You will no longer be able to create or edit presentations. Your trial will be canceled immediately. Then Cancel plan. No reason form, no discount offer, no password and no support contact. After a reload Billing showed Your trial has been canceled, Pro - Trial Canceled, and Your workspace will be downgraded at the end of the current billing cycle, Dec 03, 2026. Not tested: Generate Ideas, the Offline Player, a real export to PowerPoint or PDF, public sharing, editing chart figures, the Team plan and PowerPoint import. Clean up: two presentations stay; the trial is cancelled and the account language is now English. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The trial defaults to annual billing. Switching a chart slide to another layout drops the chart data. The cancel dialog says the trial ends immediately, while Billing keeps access until Dec 03, 2026.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.
friction.cancellation: Cancelling takes 2 screens in Billing with no reason, offer or password; the first screen points to the ChatGPT app. The dialog says the trial ends immediately, but Billing then shows access until Dec 03, 2026.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Beautiful.ai in the 14-day Pro trial that we started with our card. The trial runs on annual billing, so the first bill is $174.00. One prompt gave a polished 8-slide deck in about 55 seconds, but with placeholders instead of figures, and a layout switch dropped the chart. Cancelling took 2 screens with no offer. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day Pro trial with his own card; the trial checkout defaults to annual billing. Our AI assistant ran the test in its own tab on 19 November 2026 from 17:46 CET. The account was in Dutch; we set the language to English in the preferences before the first screenshot. Billing at the start: Current Plan: Pro - You have 14 days remaining in your free trial, Billing Period: Annual, Your next bill of $174.00 will be due when your free trial ends on Dec 03, 2026, Seats: 1 total. Payment history has one line of $0. Core action, a deck from a prompt: Create with AI, the prompt Quarterly update for a small bakery, a few quick questions with the defaults kept, then an outline of 8 slides and the deck about 30 seconds after Generate presentation: about 55 seconds and 5 steps in all. The deck uses placeholders instead of figures, such as Quarterly Performance Review: [Bakery Name], $[Placeholder] and [X]%, with generated bakery photos and a chart slide. Smart Slides: switching the Revenue Drivers chart slide to a list layout took one click, but the chart and the 68% figure did not carry over; Undo brought them back. A template, Corporate Presentation Template, opened in the editor after about 10 seconds. The Brand Kit screen covers colours, typography, decoration, footer and import from PowerPoint; nothing was changed. Share and export, only viewed: Share Securely offers Password Protection and Viewer Authentication; export offers a view link, Offline Player, PDF, PowerPoint and Google Slides, with the note Exported presentations do not support animations or video at this time. Nothing was shared or downloaded. Plans: Pro $14.50 /mo billed annually, Team $40 /mo with 3 seats included billed annually, Enterprise custom. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen; it defaulted to annual billing at $174 a year. Cancelling, done the same day: Billing, Manage plan, Cancel plan. Screen 1, Already working in ChatGPT?, with Continue to cancellation. Screen 2: Are you sure you want to cancel your plan? You will no longer be able to create or edit presentations. Your trial will be canceled immediately. Then Cancel plan. No reason form, no discount offer, no password and no support contact. After a reload Billing showed Your trial has been canceled, Pro - Trial Canceled, and Your workspace will be downgraded at the end of the current billing cycle, Dec 03, 2026. Not tested: Generate Ideas, the Offline Player, a real export to PowerPoint or PDF, public sharing, editing chart figures, the Team plan and PowerPoint import. Clean up: two presentations stay; the trial is cancelled and the account language is now English. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The trial defaults to annual billing. Switching a chart slide to another layout drops the chart data. The cancel dialog says the trial ends immediately, while Billing keeps access until Dec 03, 2026.
